resists.volcanic-shaman: Cap fire and necrotic. Almost all of the harm is those two.

resists.husk-of-elder-gaspar: Cap void, fire, cold, and lightning. Heavy hits use all four.

resists.aberroth: Cap void and physical. Those are the defenses this fight asks for.
